releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.notes:
## What this is

`skill_management` adds a switchboard for the skills installed in your OpenCode setup: see what is installed, find out why one will not load, take one out of the model's view, and put it back.

Disabling never touches skill files. It writes **one** `skill` permission rule into your global config (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable). Nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing that rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

This is the first stable release: the surface described below is frozen for 1.x.

## What it does

| Action | What it does | Writes config |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | Every registered skill with its effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`) | no |
| `inspect` | Why one skill is (un)available: the matching rule, per-agent differences, how its id was derived | no |
| `disable` | Hide it from the model and reject loading it (`effect: "ask"` keeps it listed and asks on load) | yes |
| `enable` | Remove the blocking rule again, whoever wrote it | yes |

How a permission is resolved: the host reads the rule set of **the agent that is calling**, takes the last match (`findLast`) with `*` / `?` globs, and — when nothing matches — falls back to `ask`, not `allow`. That is why `list` and `inspect` evaluate per agent and name the agent they used.

en.headline: 58 commits across four repositories and one v1.0.0 release
en.summary: The day included **58 commits** across four repositories, with no pull requests, issues, or reviews recorded. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 40 own commits redesigned the options and popup UI, added NVIDIA presets and Riva protocol support, introduced asynchronous review with ID-based patches and undo, and added a local debug log backend. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 10 own commits added CLI help, decoupled provider chains into `config/providers.json`, connected NVIDIA to the daily-report chain, and retired the minimax and longcat free legs; 37 additional automated commits were created by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 7 own commits added a bilingual Astro and Starlight documentation site, aligned its mobile landing page, and prepared the `v1.0.0` release. The `v1.0.0` release introduced a skill switchboard with `list` and `inspect` actions and permission-rule-based disabling that does not modify skill files. One further own commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` documented planning capabilities. Issue `openchamber/openchamber#5489` received a reply from `openchamber-bot[bot]` and was closed by `yulia-ivashko`.

releaseNotes.summary: This first stable release provides a switchboard for OpenCode skills, including `list` and `inspect` actions. Disabling a skill writes a single `skill` permission rule with `effect: "deny"` or `"ask"` rather than deleting, moving, or rewriting skill files.

zh.headline: 四个仓库共 58 次提交，并发布 v1.0.0
zh.summary: 当天在四个仓库完成 **58 次提交**，未记录拉取请求、issue 或评审。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 40 次本人提交重做了选项与弹窗界面，加入 NVIDIA 预设、Riva 协议、基于 ID 的异步评审与撤销功能，并增加本地调试日志后端。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 10 次本人提交加入 CLI 帮助，将 provider 链解耦到 `config/providers.json`，把 NVIDIA 接入日报链首，并下线 minimax 与 longcat 免费链；另有 37 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 7 次本人提交新增 Astro 与 Starlight 双语文档站，对齐移动端落地页，并完成 `v1.0.0` 发布准备。`v1.0.0` 发布技能切换面板，提供 `list` 与 `inspect` 操作，停用技能时仅写入一条权限规则，不修改技能文件。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 另有 1 次本人提交，整理规划类能力文档。`openchamber/openchamber#5489` 收到 `openchamber-bot[bot]` 的回复，随后由 `yulia-ivashko` 关闭。

releaseNotes.summary: 首个稳定版本提供 OpenCode 技能切换面板，包含 `list` 与 `inspect` 操作。停用技能时仅写入一条 `skill` 权限规则，设置 `effect: "deny"` 或 `"ask"`，不会删除、移动或重写技能文件。
